thesis: The episode features a conversation between Chris Dixon and Kevin Rose regarding their transition from Web2 veterans to participants in the Web3 movement. They discuss tech trends including NFTs, AI, copyright evolution, and the shifting geographic center of tech innovation from Silicon Valley to Los Angeles and New York.
